items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1958-06-19, 20
items.q: And the trombone player was Ned Mack.

ctx.x: Who was in the band then?

Do you remember the name? Howard Walker's band. That fella by the name of Wheaton, Alexander, played alto sack. And they had another young fella. Used to be on the show there. I can't think of his name. Anyway, they had another carnet player. I was playing the second trumpet. This boy had been with Harry Brandt, my old wife, named Charlie, too. Just like me, Charlie Boyer. He was a nice trumpet player. Charlie Boyer. And the trombone player was Ned Mack. And we had Jackson from Mobile, a band-a-play. He was good.…
Drums. He used to play with Lee Collins. Yeah, I remember.
